oneLiner: Know exactly which houseplants need water today, and keep every one of them alive.
problem: Plant owners forget watering schedules, especially once they have more than a few plants with different needs. Plants die from both neglect and overwatering, and generic reminder apps don't know that a cactus and a fern need different care.
audience: Urban plant owners with 3–30 houseplants, mostly 20–40 year olds who are new to plant care and want simple guidance.
coreLoop: Open the app, see the 'Today' list of plants that are due or overdue for water, tap each plant as you water it (with a satisfying haptic + streak bump), and glance at what's coming up in the next few days.
differentiator: Per-plant watering intervals with sensible presets by plant type, a care streak that rewards consistency, and a zero-setup, fully offline experience — no account, no ads.
mvpFeatures: Add plants with name, room, plant type preset and custom watering interval
Today view: plants due/overdue sorted by urgency with one-tap 'Watered'
Plant detail with watering history and next due date; edit or delete plant
Care streak: consecutive days with all due plants watered
Upcoming view: next 7 days of watering grouped by day

source.value: an app that helps people keep their houseplants alive - track each plant, when to water it, and keep a streak

risks.risk: Too simple — could be seen as minimum functionality
risks.mitigation: Ship five real features, polished native UI, haptics, history and streak logic, offline-first

risks.risk: Empty first launch looks broken to reviewers
risks.mitigation: Friendly empty state with one-tap 'Add your first plant' and quick-add presets

openQuestions: Final app name and trademark search
